discrepancies.description: The invoice is CIF and itemises $4,500.00 of international freight/insurance. These are excluded from transaction value under 19 U.S.C. 1401a(b)(4)(A). If the entry was filed at the CIF total, entered value is overstated by $4,500.00: estimated excess duty of $275.30 at the invoice's value-weighted rate.
discrepancies.executive_summary: $4,500.00 of non-dutiable CIF charges may be inflating entered value.
discrepancies.financial_blast_radius: Recoverable overpayment of $275.30 via Post-Summary Correction or protest.
discrepancies.statutory_defense: Deduct itemised freight/insurance on the entry summary; file a PSC (or a 19 U.S.C. 1514 protest after liquidation).
discrepancies.title: CIF Freight and Insurance Must Be Deducted From Transaction Value

discrepancies.description: Line 1: 500 units @ $45.00 = $22500.00, but the line is invoiced at $25500.00. The $3,000.00 difference overstates the value on this line.
discrepancies.financial_blast_radius: Entered value on line 1 overstates by $3,000.00.
discrepancies.statutory_defense: Obtain a corrected invoice or debit/credit memo before filing; PSC within 300 days of entry if already filed.
discrepancies.title: Invoice Line Item Arithmetic Extension Error

discrepancies.description: High-Speed AI Core Processors declared under HTS 8471.30.0100 (rate 0.0%) appears classifiable under 8542.31.0000 (rate 25.0%). Loss of duty: $31,250.00. Statutory maximum at the assumed culpability (Negligence, 19 U.S.C. 1592(c)(3)): $62,500.00. Domestic value not stated, so the domestic-value cap is not applied.
discrepancies.executive_summary: Declared 8471.30.0100 vs 8542.31.0000: $31,250.00 loss of duty; statutory maximum $62,500.00 (negligence).
discrepancies.financial_blast_radius: $31,250.00 unpaid duty plus up to $62,500.00 civil penalty.
discrepancies.statutory_defense: Consider a prior disclosure under 19 CFR 162.74 before CBP opens an inquiry: tender the $31,250.00 loss of duty; the penalty is then limited to interest on the loss of duty (about $6,336.22; 19 U.S.C. 1505, 2024-04-12 to 2026-11-20). Culpability is a legal determination for counsel.
discrepancies.title: HTS Misclassification & 19 U.S.C. § 1592 Penalty Exposure

discrepancies.description: Fuel surcharge billed at 32.50% of base freight ($1,462.50) against a contracted index rate of 24.00% ($1,080.00). Overcharge: $382.50.
discrepancies.executive_summary: FSC billed at 32.5% vs 24.0% contracted: $382.50 over.
discrepancies.statutory_defense: Short-pay the variance and dispute it with the carrier, citing the service contract fuel clause.
discrepancies.title: Fuel Surcharge Billed Above Contracted Index Rate

discrepancies.description: The carrier billed $285.00 for a chassis split, and no shipper work order or accessorial authorisation is referenced on the invoice. Accessorials are payable only where the service contract or published tariff provides for them.
discrepancies.statutory_defense: Request the work order or tariff rule; dispute the line if none is produced.
discrepancies.title: Chassis Split Billed Without a Work Order

discrepancies.description: Detention of $880.00 was billed, but the container was returned on day 5 of 5 calendar days of free time. Discharge 2024-03-24, out-gate 2024-03-28.
discrepancies.executive_summary: Detention charged on day 5 of 5 free days.
discrepancies.statutory_defense: Dispute within the period stated on the invoice (at least 30 days from issuance, 46 CFR 541.8); the billing party must respond within 30 days of the dispute.
discrepancies.title: Detention Billed Inside Port Free Time

discrepancies.executive_summary: 1,000 units match import to export: $27,324.00 refundable.
discrepancies.financial_blast_radius: $27,324.00 refundable on liquidation of the drawback claim.

discrepancies.statutory_defense: File a drawback entry (type 47) in ACE; keep import, export and matching records for 3 years after liquidation.

discrepancies.executive_summary: Import and export records reconcile on quantity and basis.
discrepancies.financial_blast_radius: Supports the $27,324.00 claim on CBP review.
discrepancies.statutory_defense: Retain the matching record with the claim.

Aggregate blocked ownership is 55%, so the entity is blocked by operation of law under the OFAC 50 Percent Rule. discrepancies.statutory_defense: Block the property, do not proceed, and report to OFAC within 10 business days (31 CFR 501.603).

Port Director, U.S. Customs and Border Protection
Fines, Penalties, and Forfeitures Officer
Port of Los Angeles / Long Beach (2704)

FROM:
Importer of Record: Pacific Tech Imports LLC (EIN 94-8291048)
[Subject to Review by Licensed Customs Broker or Legal Counsel]

SUBJECT: Prior Disclosure of Inadvertent Valuation Understatement Pertaining to Assists
         Under 19 U.S.C. § 1401a and 19 CFR § 152.103 on Entry #CBP-7501-84920184

1. STATUTORY NOTICE OF VOLUNTARY DISCLOSURE
Pursuant to Section 592(c)(4) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended (19 U.S.C. § 1592(c)(4)),
and Section 162.74 of the Customs Regulations (19 CFR § 162.74), the Importer of Record
hereby formally discloses circumstances of a violation of 19 U.S.C. § 1592 prior to, or without
knowledge of, the formal commencement of an investigation by U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

2. AFFECTED MERCHANDISE AND ENTRY IDENTIFICATION
- Entry Number: CBP-7501-84920184
- Declared Transaction Value: $450,000.00 USD
- Port of Entry: Los Angeles / Long Beach (2704)
- Applicable HTS General Duty Rate: 5.40%

3. NARRATIVE EXPLANATION OF CIRCUMSTANCES
During an internal compliance review, the Importer identified that certain assists provided to the foreign manufacturer
(specifically tools, dies, molds, and foreign engineering design qualifying under 19 U.S.C. § 1401a(h)(1)(A))
were omitted from the dutiable value declared upon entry.
[IMPORTER / COUNSEL TO VERIFY CIRCUMSTANCES OF OMISSION].

Furthermore, commercial invoice review indicates that CIF ocean freight of $24,500.00
and marine insurance of $3,200.00 were included in the entered
value contrary to 19 CFR § 152.103.

4. STATUTORY RECONCILIATION & MATHEMATICAL DETERMINATION (100% PYTHON DECIMAL)
- Declared Transaction Value:               $450,000.00
- Less: Excludable Ocean Freight/Insurance: -$27,700.00
- Plus: Unapportioned Statutory Assists:    +$57,750.00
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Adjusted Lawful Dutiable Value:           $480,050.00
- Lawful Customs Duty Due:                  $25,922.70
- Customs Duty Previously Tendered:         $24,300.00
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
- ACTUAL DUTY LOSS / UNDERPAYMENT:          $1,622.70
- STATUTORY INTEREST DUE (19 U.S.C. § 1505): $87.21
=========================================================================
- TOTAL TENDER CHECK ENCLOSED (STATUTORY TENDER COMPUTED): $1,709.91

5. PENALTY MITIGATION EFFECTUATION
Under 19 U.S.C. § 1592(c)(4) and 19 CFR § 162.74, upon tender of the actual duty loss
plus statutory interest and satisfaction of all filing criteria, civil penalties under
19 U.S.C. § 1592(c)(4)(B) for negligence or gross negligence are limited to interest
on the loss of duty. Against the negligence maximum of $3,245.40
that is a reduction of $3,158.19 (gross negligence maximum:
$6,490.80). Culpability is a determination for counsel.

Respectfully submitted,
Pacific Tech Imports LLC (EIN 94-8291048)
